title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
SENIOR DATA ENGINEER

£105,000 + 10% Bonus

LONDON

This is an exciting opportunity to join a highly regarded WealthTech business undergoing a major data platform transformation. You'll take ownership of key data engineering projects, working with modern technologies including Snowflake and dbt, while gaining exposure to architecture and solution design. Working closely with an experienced BI Architect and business stakeholders, you'll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and play a key role in the continued development of the data platform.

THE COMPANY

Our client is an established and highly regarded financial technology business operating within the UK investment and wealth management market. The organisation provides technology that supports financial advisers in managing investments, pensions and other financial products for clients across the UK. With a strong market position and significant assets under administration, the business continues to invest in its technology and data capabilities. This is an opportunity to join a collaborative technology function, working within an established business that offers long-term stability alongside continued investment in modern data platforms and innovation.

THE ROLE

  • Design, build and maintain scalable data engineering solutions across the business
  • Take ownership of data projects from initial requirements through to delivery and implementation
  • Develop and optimise SQL-based data pipelines and support data ingestion using Python
  • Work extensively with Snowflake and dbt within a modern cloud data environment
  • Contribute to the ongoing development and optimisation of the data platform

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years' experience in Data Engineering, ideally at Senior level
  • Strong commercial experience with Snowflake, dbt and SQL
  • Proven experience designing, building and maintaining data pipelines
  • Understanding of data modelling and modern cloud data platforms
  • Exposure to Power BI and semantic layer development would be advantageous
  • Financial Services experience would be beneficial but is not essential

SALARY AND BENEFITS

  • 10% discretionary annual bonus
  • Additional benefits package
  • Hybrid working (2 days per week in the London office, with flexibility over which days)
  • Opportunity to develop architectural expertise alongside an experienced BI Architect
  • Exposure to modern data technologies and emerging AI initiatives

HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest by sending your CV through to Harry Lack via the 'Apply' link.
